about: THE OWNER'S TEST PHOTOGRAPHS. Every file in the Drive folders the owner shared for testing, and nothing else. Calibration, look tuning and every render a record reports are done on these, opened through the app so its per-camera behaviour applies (the lens fix is matched from EXIF). The practice DNGs in public/examples/ carry no EXIF and are for decode and geometry only. Never search Drive beyond these folders. Read and fetched through tools/owner-images.mjs. Hub LESSONS 369.
